title: Tell me about yourself
description: Answer the opening interview question, aimed at the specific role or programme you are applying to.

userInputs.label: What role or programme are you applying to?

brief.scene: You are in a formal interview for {{role}}. This is the first question.
brief.yourGoal: Answer in under two minutes, aimed at the role, not your whole life story.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.persona: A formal interviewer opening the interview
turns.generate: Welcome the candidate to the interview for {{role}} and ask them to tell you about themselves. One or two sentences only. Reply with one spoken line under 40 words. No stage directions, no markdown, no preamble.

judged.label: Relevance to the role
judged.criterion: The answer is aimed at the stated role or programme. Most of what the speaker says connects to why they suit it; personal background appears only where it supports that case.

criteriaDisplay: Keep filler words under 4 per minute
Speak between 120 and 170 words per minute
Aim your answer at the role, not your whole life story
